title: Legal holds
description: Records kept whatever a delete, the recycle bin's purge, a retention rule or an account deletion would do. A hold names a kind of record and one record, or every record of that kind. It lasts until it is released.

place.title: Place a legal hold
place.description: While the hold is active the record cannot be deleted, is left in the recycle bin and is skipped by the retention rules. A hold on a User also stops that person's account deletion.
place.subject: Subject
place.subjectHint: The kind of record, such as Note, or User for a person.
place.subjectInvalid: A subject is a name such as Note.
place.recordIdHint: Leave empty to hold every record of the subject, the ones made later too.
place.recordInvalid: A record ID is a UUID.
place.reasonHint: Kept with the hold, for whoever reads the list later.
place.reasonTooLong: A reason is at most 1000 characters.

release.title: Release the hold on {{subject}}
release.description: The records it kept can be deleted and purged again. The hold stays in the list as released.
release.noteTooLong: A note is at most 1000 characters.

detail.title: Legal hold
detail.description: What is held, why, and who placed or released it.
detail.subject: Subject
